name: SAGE Camp (Science Accelerating Growth and Engagement)
what_you_do: Join a summer day camp at the laboratory with hands-on projects, job shadowing and facility tours. It runs about a week and a half.
who_can_apply: Students ages 14 to 17 who will be in grade 10, 11 or 12 and are under 18. You must be able to attend the full camp.
pay_detail: Pay and cost are not stated
deadline_text: SAGE 2027 is July 12 to 22, 2027. The page says summer 2027 applications are expected to open in early 2027.
how_to_apply: The page gives no steps yet. Email the ORNL K-12 Education team (address on the SAGE page) or call 865-576-7658.
notes: The camp is at 1 Bethel Valley Road, Oak Ridge, TN 37830. Residency rules are not stated. Ask the K-12 team about cost and who can apply.
